description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.
